source_note: 从一个求极限问题引入Weyl判别
english_source_note: Introducing Weyl's Criterion via a Limit Problem
callout_id: 从一个求极限问题引入Weyl判别#2
statement_en:
If $s_n$ is equidistributed on the closed interval $[a,b]$, then
$$\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}f(s_n)\to
\frac{1}{b-a}\int_{a}^{b}f(x)dx$$
for every continuous function $f$.
callout_body:
如果$s_n$在闭区间$[a,b]$上**均匀分布(equidistributed)**，那么$$\frac{1}{N}\sum_{n=1}^{N}f(s_n)\to
\frac{1}{b-a}\int_{a}^{b}f(x)dx$$此结果对任意连续函数$f$成立。
